verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI assistant that acts on email, calendar and integrations, so the story applies. Nothing in the pack describes acting on many items at once (for example batch email triage or mass updates). The closest items say Poke can 'perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation', which concerns breadth across services, not bulk action over many items. The API and recipe docs cover sending messages and setting up automations, not batch operations.
